title: Concept: Dynamic code evaluation via erl_eval:expr (erlang) — review required
description: In erlang, erl_eval:expr turns a string into running code. Evaluation sinks collapse the data/code boundary, so any untrusted bytes in the string become an injection primitive. The erlang-specific remedy is data-only handling via a fixed parser over an allowlist of operations.
applicability: erlang codebases that build code or expressions from strings via erl_eval:expr; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Code execution in the application process when untrusted input reaches the sink; HIGH severity because evaluation sinks rarely constrain what the injected code can do.
